SELECT a.accindex, 
       sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore' as botlik,
       sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore' as auto,
       m.convnatval,
       a.acctstatus
FROM account a
JOIN profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
JOIN contentbehavior cb ON sb.sessref = cb.cntsessref
JOIN messaginganalysis m ON cb.cntref = m.msgcntref
JOIN networkmetrics nm ON sb.sessref = nm.netsessref
JOIN technicalinfo ti ON nm.netkey = ti.technetref
JOIN securitydetection sd ON ti.techkey = sd.sectechref
WHERE a.acctstatus = 'Dormant'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT a.accindex AS account_id,
       ROUND(CAST(0.4 * (sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore')::numeric 
                  + 0.3 * (sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore')::numeric 
                  + 0.3 * (1 - m.convnatval) AS numeric), 4) AS bbi_score,
       CASE 
           WHEN (0.4 * (sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore')::numeric 
                 + 0.3 * (sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore')::numeric 
                 + 0.3 * (1 - m.convnatval)) > 0.9 THEN 'High'
           WHEN (0.4 * (sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore')::numeric 
                 + 0.3 * (sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore')::numeric 
                 + 0.3 * (1 - m.convnatval)) >= 0.3 THEN 'Moderate'
           ELSE 'Low Risk'
       END AS risk_tier
FROM account a
JOIN profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
JOIN contentbehavior cb ON sb.sessref = cb.cntsessref
JOIN messaginganalysis m ON cb.cntref = m.msgcntref
JOIN networkmetrics nm ON sb.sessref = nm.netsessref
JOIN technicalinfo ti ON nm.netkey = ti.technetref
JOIN securitydetection sd ON ti.techkey = sd.sectechref
WHERE a.acctstatus = 'Dormant'
  AND (0.4 * (sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore')::numeric 
       + 0.3 * (sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore')::numeric 
       + 0.3 * (1 - m.convnatval)) > 0.2
ORDER BY bbi_score DESC

FROM account a

JOIN technicalinfo ti ON nm.netkey = ti.technetref
JOIN securitydetection sd ON ti.techkey = sd.sectechref

LIMIT 10;

SELECT a.accindex AS account_id,

JOIN networkmetrics nm ON sb.sessref = nm.netsessref
